title: Retention Concessions on Noticed Rent Increases: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement Reference
content:
**Policy entry.** A tenant of a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement who calls about a noticed existing-customer increase within the request window is given one retention concession, noticed with the increase's effective date and pointing at the increase, whose new rent is the increase's rent as it stands less the give-back, the give-back rounded down to the cent.

**When the concession is figured.** The retention concession is not figured until the agreement's rent changes show its noticed increase at or within the increase limit. In the words of the record: the concession waits until the rent change history shows the noticed increase standing at a rent at or within the increase limit.

## The concession tool

The concession is recorded with the agent-side tool `grant_unit_retention_concession_f9ae06a9`, which the agent unlocks and then calls. One call records one retention concession notice, dated today, that points at the increase notice it gives part of back, keeps that increase's effective date and its rent before the change, and carries the conceded monthly rent as the new rent from that effective date; the agreement's current rent is not changed by the call. The tenant sees the conceded rent in the agreement's rent change history and in the confirmation sent.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_id` | the storage unit rental agreement number, read from the rental agreement lookup | identifier |
| `source_rate_change_id` | the rent change number of the existing-customer increase notice the concession applies to, read from the agreement's rent change lookup | identifier |
| `new_rent` | the conceded monthly rent from the increase's effective date, in US dollars | 2 decimal places; more places are rounded to the cent |

**Return.** The call succeeds when the receipt returns the new rent change number: `rate_change_id`, `rental_id`, `source_rate_change_id` (the increase notice the concession applies to), `change_reason` (always `retention_concession`), `previous_rent` (the rent before the increase), `new_rent` (the conceded rent), `notice_date` (today) and `effective_date` (the increase's effective date).

## Contract notes
- `source_rate_change_id` names the existing-customer increase notice itself.
- The concession notice carries the increase's effective date, whatever day the concession is granted.
